title: Excerpta Latina Barbari (Barbarus Scaligeri; 'Alexandrian World Chronicle')
author: Anonymous Alexandrian compiler; anonymous Frankish translator
date: Greek original 527–539 CE; Latin version 8th c.
edition: Frick, Chronica minora I (1892; public domain). Schoene 1875 (public domain)
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia (Excerpta Latina Barbari) cites only Western scholarship. No Russian translation listed or found
en_evidence: B. Garstad, Apocalypse of Pseudo-Methodius: An Alexandrian World Chronicle (DOML, HUP 2012), per en.wikipedia
value: Ptolemaic, Seleucid and Macedonian king-lists from Africanus, Alexander and Nebuchadnezzar narratives, and Alexandrian prefects. Shows how late antiquity transmitted Hellenistic history; fits the Alexander tradition.
ai_feasibility: Medium: the barbarous Latin needs reconstruction of the Greek behind it, which makes it a good test of multi-model review
pilot_unit: King-lists from Assyria to the Ptolemies, including the Alexander passage, est. 5k words
